note: Both sets mix sound text-derived claims with many unreliable readings off the dual-axis plot, but Set A is more accurate overall: it correctly captures K_P(θ=0°)=0.01882681 s, K_I(θ=0°)=0.008068634, K_D=0.0 s² and ζφ=0.7, and its curve readings (GK≈0.53/0.36/0.22 at 5/10/20°, K_P≈0.005 s and K_I≈0.002 at 20°) are mostly consistent with the figure. Set B adds the correct GK(θ)=1/(1+θ/θ_K) formula and the gain-scheduled PI type, which Set A omits, but it misstates the integral gain at 0° (0.005/0.3) and never gives the correct K_I value, and it has more left-axis/right-axis confusions (0.75 s, 0.42 s, 0.3 s, 0.18, 0.12, 0.3 at x=0). Both repeat the misread K_P=0.018182881 s and the unsupported 0.8 s / 0.18 s / 0.020 s readings, so Set A wins mainly on fewer misbindings and better retention of the stated gains.
